With that in mind
Travel notice for pet journeys

Travelers should review the latest Companion Animal Travel Desk guidance before arriving at Aurelia Skyways with a pet. This helps us keep check-in calm, steady, and fair for every family.

Please use a secure carrier, bring the right travel papers, and allow extra room in your plan for a careful review. If a concern comes up, our team follows a calm stepwise review and listens closely so we can guide you to the best next step. <<FACT F001>> Keep your pet close, follow staff directions, and let us know early if you need support with a nervous animal.

For crowded departure days, space can be limited and the pet lounge may need careful scheduling. <<FACT F008>> We ask travelers to arrive prepared, because a small delay at the desk is easier to manage when documents and carriers are ready.

Please speak with the Companion Animal Travel Desk for help before you travel.
